row.name: stackyard
row.description: Free, open-source app for Windows and macOS that finds every SDK and toolchain on your machine (Flutter, Node.js, Android SDK, Xcode simulators, Java, Python, .NET, Gradle), shows which projects use each version, fixes broken setups in one click and frees disk space.
